title: Forecrew environment
description: Schema of .forecrew/environments/<name>.yaml, written by the environment engineer and approved with the test plan (test_plan_approval gate). An environment says where a command job runs: a Docker image (provider docker), the worker's host (machine) or a GitHub-hosted runner (actions). It never holds secrets: names that look like secrets are refused. internal/testsys validates it (this schema, then the rules of domain.Environment.Validate). Resolved, it is the environment of a command job's spec (job-spec.md).

relPath.description: Path relative to the repo root, with / separators; it must not start with / or contain .. segments.

label.description: Worker label; compared case-insensitively and normalized like jobs.needs.

envMap.description: Non-secret environment variables. Names that are, or end in _ followed by, TOKEN, SECRET, PASSWORD or KEY (any case) are refused: secrets never go in repo files.

image.description: Image of the service container, with a pinned tag.

ports.description: Container ports the job reaches at <service name>:<port>.

health.description: How the service is known to be ready; the job starts only then.

command.description: Shell command run in the service container; exit 0 means ready.

retries.description: Tries before the job fails as errored; default 30.

name.description: Must equal the file name without .yaml.

provider.description: docker: a container on a worker with the docker label. machine: the worker's host as it is. actions: a GitHub-hosted runner, pool actions.

image.description: docker: image to pull, with a pinned tag or digest.

context.description: docker: build context of dockerfile; default the repo root.

devcontainer.description: docker: a devcontainer.json. Only image, build.dockerfile, build.context, containerEnv and postCreateCommand are used; other keys are ignored.

runs_on.description: actions: GitHub-hosted runner label, e.g. ubuntu-24.04, windows-2025, macos-15.

needs.description: Worker labels the job needs on top of the provider's (docker implies docker). Not used by actions.

setup.description: Commands run once: when the image is built (docker), before each job (machine) or as workflow steps (actions).

versions.description: Tool name -> command whose output the job records as that tool's version, e.g. go: go version.

services.description: Service name -> container started next to the job on a per-job network. Only for provider docker; machine and actions refuse them.
